title: The Protocol of Sector Nine
author: Dominic Ishikawa
blurb: Casper Fairweather, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
